tool.title: Stage a site's shared asset directories where the host serves them
tool.description: Write each shared directory of a built site (its `assets/…` laid out as a built site) to `<out>/shared/<dir>/<key>/` with a `.shared.json`, so sites on one host load one copy instead of one each. A directory already there is left alone. This is the host side of the shared-assets step `build-instance-site` runs when a checkout declares `site.sharedAssets`; run on its own, it stages an IG build, or any built site, into a host site root.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: A directory laid out as a built site, holding `assets/…`.

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: The host site root the shared directories are written under.

outputs.name: staged
outputs.description: One line per shared directory: `staged` or `already there`, with its path under `shared/`.

selection.when: Composing a layer's site for a host that serves shared assets, or staging an IG build's assets into such a host.
selection.limits: Copies only; it does not rewrite the pages that load the assets. `build-instance-site` does both in one run.
selection.cost: A local copy of the shared directories: seconds.
